## Objective
- Upgrade the existing CD 70 ride game with throttle and clutch sliders plus a stall system and more realistic riding mechanics.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game or apply the requested change without asking clarifying questions.
- Save checks as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Added slider controls alongside existing keyboard inputs; clutch engagement affects drivetrain coupling, engine RPM, and the risk of stalling.
- Added engine restart behavior and stall guidance. Restart is possible through the UI button or `R`, and requires the clutch when in gear.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `index.html` with throttle/clutch sliders, RPM and engine status displays, stall logic, restart controls, and clutch-gated gear shifting.
- Extracted the module script and passed `node --check`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Started a local server and opened the game in Playwright; page loaded with title `CD 70: First Ride`.

### Active
- Browser check of the ride controls and gameplay, including capturing and inspecting the requested JPEG.

### Blocked
- An attempted Playwright `run-code` command failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier 'page'`; no JPEG was captured or inspected yet.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing from the open game at `http://localhost:3002`; use valid Playwright CLI commands to get the player to the bike and verify riding, sliders, shifting, and stalling.
2. Save a JPEG at or below 1280px wide, then inspect the latest screenshot.
3. Review `git diff` and summarize the completed change and any remaining caveats.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Existing game and all current gameplay/UI changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The initial game mission requires walking to and opening the garage shutter, then interacting with the bike before the ride controls become active.
- Playwright reported a missing `/favicon.ico` (404) and WebGL performance warnings; no application JavaScript error was observed.
